description: This file defines a utility enum 'GenericPasswordKeychainStore' that provides static methods for storing, loading, and deleting generic password entries in the iOS/macOS Keychain. It encapsulates Keychain interactions such as saving string data, loading data, and removing items, with internal helpers for constructing queries.

methods.name: loadString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value for the given service and account from the Keychain, returning nil if not found or on failure.

methods.name: saveString
methods.description: Saves a string value to the Keychain for the specified service and account, with optional accessibility attribute.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the Keychain item for the specified service and account.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Internal method that loads Data object from the Keychain for given service and account.

methods.name: saveData
methods.description: Internal method that saves Data to the Keychain for given service and account, with rollback on failure.

methods.name: baseQuery
methods.description: Constructs a Keychain query dictionary for the given service and account.
